name: lot_developer_demolition_explosion
description: Demolition and explosion (§7). StartDemolishLot: with lot flags & 1 it demolishes flora in the cell area, removes the lot props, writes the zot property 0, removes the network connection nodes, then ClearLotBuildings(lot, 5, true, 0), which sets state 5, and for each building removes its props, its foundation (removeFoundation true) and the occupant, and finally removes whatever zot is shown. EndDemolishLot: only when the lot is initialized, SetState(6), ClearLot (which leaves a kept lot in state 1 after setting 6, quirk 13), and for zones {0,11,12,15} DeleteLot. ClearLot resets the vertices lock, sets state 1, building type 0, configuration null and the empty base texture. ExplodeLot: state 5 or 6 does nothing; otherwise a burnt-building prop is made from the first building, ClearLotBuildings(lot, 6, false, 4), the props and network nodes are removed, and with a building a terrain decal (instance 0x49C80EC7 burnt / 0x2A2EF55D not), the rubble props and the burnt building are added; burnt also sets condition 6; finally the building type is cleared.

steps.note: the building's foundation (kind 1); slot 60 finds it with the vertical line at (0 - 0.05, 0 + 0.05) under the building's position (§17.5.1)
ClearLotBuildings sets state 5 (destructing) and slot 11 clears the zot
flags & 1: flora demolished; then the lot props, the network nodes, and ClearLotBuildings
ClearLot leaves a kept lot in state 1 after SetState(6) (quirk 13), building type 0, configuration null
zone 1 is not in {0,11,12,15}: not deleted
ClearLot ends with SetEmptyLotBaseTexture (§17.7): one SetTextureSpecification
